On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss Nvidia reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO. On today’s show, Arbroath Group Managing Partner Christopher Smart, Rep. Sharice Davids (D-KS), Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, The Watchdog Report Publisher Kurt Bardella and former Republican Congressman Patrick McHenry.
